name: hetzner-throwaway-server-fixture
description: Shared throwaway-Hetzner-server CI fixture for the round-7 tracks deploy-hetzner-server (mint), platform-docker-compose-host (extend, T-2), edge-cloudflare-tunnel (extend, T-3). Provisions a cx23 in fsn1 from ubuntu-24.04 per hetzner/servers/ci-throwaway.json, tags with role=rcf-lite-ci-throwaway, tears down in always() via destroy.mjs, and gates on CI_HAS_HETZNER_ACCOUNT per hetzner-round-7-spec-2026-09-07.md section 3.3. Round-7 T-2 (platform-docker-compose-host) extends this fixture with a minimal compose stack (compose.yaml, caddy/Caddyfile, secrets/web-token file mount, src/serve.mjs healthchecked stub) and five run-<probe>.mjs delegate shims that call the blueprint probes.
